name: Viv the Game
source:
A visual novel about the squirrel Vivien, who works as a barista in a coffee van. In general her life is very ordinary and boring. However, at some point it was as if a switch was flipped and problems began to fall on her shoulders, one after another. Actions take place in the world of anthropomorphic animals where there are rules and laws!

[Edited from [URL=https://vivthegame.itch.io/viv-the-game]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
一部关于松鼠薇薇安的视觉小说，她在咖啡车里担任咖啡师。总的来说，她的生活很平凡，也很无聊。然而，在某个时候，就像开关被打开一样，问题开始接二连三地落在她的肩上。行动发生在拟人化动物的世界里，那里有规则和法律！

[编辑自 [URL=https://vivthegame.itch.io/viv-the-game]itch.io[/URL]]
